scope: Question, answer, chart labels and follow-up navigation in the local Streamlit app

browser.stack: Headless Chromium, private Streamlit/FastAPI ports, native PostgreSQL with a deterministic presentation model
browser.question: Compare failed payments by bank for October 1–14 and October 15–28, 2026, in Asia/Kolkata.
checks: Saved question and verified headline visible, independent question composer absent
Two period cards and a two-series bank chart, visible natural-language follow-up
Chat history includes the same question and headline and reopens the chart
390 px mobile viewport fits the page and switches the chart to a table

live_provider: This presentation check used a model double. The six earlier live model layout checks are recorded in generative_ui_acceptance.json.
